job_description:
Responsibilities: We are looking for a proactive and energetic Brand Promoter who will help expand our job seeker community. The role involves onboarding job seekers, guiding them about career opportunities, and promoting the company’s services through direct engagement and brand campaigns.

Job Responsibilities:

- Identify and onboard new job seekers to the platform through direct communication and field engagement.
- Educate and train job seekers on how to create profiles, apply for jobs, and utilize platform services effectively.
- Conduct manual brand promotion campaigns in targeted locations (universities, training centers, public areas, etc.).
- Promote company services and maintain strong relationships with job seekers.
- Support in community building and awareness activities for job seekers.
- Collect feedback from users and share insights with the internal team.
- Assist the marketing team in executing offline promotional activities.
- Perform other relevant promotional and engagement tasks assigned by management.

Preferred Skills:

- Presentation and training ability.
- Public speaking or campaign experience.
- Passion for helping job seekers and building communities.
- Basic understanding of social media and mobile apps is mandatory.

Benefits:

- Competitive salary and performance incentives.
- Opportunity to work with a fast-growing HR & job platform.
- Professional development and networking opportunities.

Requirements: - Candidates must have completed at least H.S.C (Graduate candidates will get preference)
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to engage with people and explain services clearly.
- Willingness to work in the field and run promotional activities.
- Must have the ability for extensive travel to anywhere in Bangladesh.
